review.brief: Review CH46 (platform-harden-docker-deploy) as merged, plus the post-merge fix c7e7895. Priority 1: the corrected path rule. design.md Trap 3 was WRONG once already and shipped; verify the correction is right AND complete — every relative path in deploy/docker/compose.yaml must resolve from the repo root (the --project-directory . base), and no file may still explain the old two-mechanism rule. Priority 2: compose hardening matches design.md's per-service table exactly (logging, limits, cap_drop/cap_add, read_only, tmpfs); no deploy.resources.reservations. Priority 3: every doc command carries both flags and no stale old path survives outside openspec/changes/archive/, which is immutable and must not be touched. Priority 4: anti-gaming — no task title or acceptance criterion was weakened; every task is awaiting-user-verification, not done. Signals: go build, go vet, the three guards and openspec validate were ASSISTANT-run and passed. gofmt -l flags 3 test files, pre-existing on main, CH46 edits zero .go files. docker compose config was USER-run and passed; docker compose up has NEVER run — the db read_only and caddy cap_drop risks are unproven. Judge test quality by reading, never by running. This change has no unit tests and no database object by design.

findings.note: openspec/changes/platform-harden-docker-deploy/design.md lines 88-94 (Trap 1) still show `context: ../..` as the 'Resolved' correct value for build.context, with the comment 'the repo root, from deploy/docker/'. This is the OLD, wrong resolution model (paths relative to the compose file's own folder). It directly contradicts the corrected Trap 3 section 60 lines later and the actual shipped deploy/docker/compose.yaml, which uses `context: .` (verified by reading the file: line 84 `context: .` on the migrate service, same on web and poller). A future reader who trusts Trap 1 in isolation (very plausible — it is the first trap in the doc, marked 'Resolved') could re-derive and reintroduce the exact bug that broke `docker compose config` on the owner's first run. Must be fixed before archiving — openspec/changes/archive/ is immutable, so this stale text would be frozen forever once archived.

openspec/changes/platform-harden-docker-deploy/tasks.md T3.1-T3.3 (lines ~92-106) still state the pre-fix (wrong) target values as their acceptance criteria: T3.1 says build blocks must have `context: ../..`; T3.2 says every env_file line must read `env_file: ../../.env`; T3.3 says the Caddy volume line must read `./Caddyfile:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile:ro`. None of these match the actual, corrected, owner-verified deploy/docker/compose.yaml (`context: .`, `env_file: .env` on all five services, `./deploy/docker/Caddyfile:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile:ro`). The post-merge fix commit c7e7895 updated design.md's Trap 3 and File-list table, the Makefile, and backup-db.sh, but never touched tasks.md — confirmed via `git diff ddf6ebf c7e7895 -- tasks.md`, which shows only checkbox flips, no text changes. All three checkboxes are already [x], so the task record itself is internally inconsistent: marked done against acceptance text the shipped code does not satisfy. This is a documentation/audit-trail integrity gap, not a functional bug (the code, Makefile, backup-db.sh, and all docs/README files are correct and the owner verified `docker compose config` resolves) — but tasks.md must be corrected before archive, for the same immutability reason as R1.

Re-verified against commit 9ed840f. design.md Trap 1 (lines 79-101) now reads `context: .` with an explicit note that the first version said `context: ../..` on the same wrong resolution model that broke Trap 3, and that build.context resolves from the one base path Trap 3 describes; build.dockerfile is called out as the one field that does NOT use the base path. Trap 1 and Trap 3 now agree with each other and with the shipped deploy/docker/compose.yaml (grep confirms `context: .` on all three build services, lines 86/113/152). No stale `../..` claim remains anywhere in design.md outside the corrective narrative text (the 'first version said' / 'what actually happened' passages, which are meant to stay). Fixed.

Re-verified against commit 9ed840f. tasks.md T3.1-T3.3 keep their original wrong acceptance text verbatim, as intended, with a new blockquote directly above T3.1 stating the values are wrong and were never right, giving the failing command and a three-row table (T3 said vs. shipped and verified) covering env_file, build.context, and the Caddy volume, plus a note that build.dockerfile was always correct. This is the right resolution, not just an acceptable one: it mirrors the precedent design.md's own Trap 3 already set in this same change (keep the wrong original text, mark it WRONG, append the real rule below it, rather than silently rewriting it) — a reader gets the same correction pattern in both files. Rewriting T3.1-T3.3 to match what shipped would erase the record that a wrong value was ever specified, which is indistinguishable from editing a criterion to make work look complete after the fact — exactly what the anti-gaming rule bars, even though the intent here is legitimate. The append-only block is placed immediately above T3.1, so a top-to-bottom reader meets the correction before the stale text, and it points to design.md Trap 3 for full reasoning. No further change needed. Fixed.
